descripcion_seo: High-end dinners and nights around rallies and grands prix. Commissioned by brands, organisers and private clients. Concept, production and delivery.

secciones.texto: HIGH-END DINNERS AND NIGHTS AROUND RALLIES AND GRANDS PRIX. THE CLEAREST PROOF OF HOW WE WORK.

secciones.frase:
The engine makes the noise.
We do the rest.

secciones.subtitulo: HOW WE STRUCTURE AN EVENING · THE SCRIPT ADAPTS TO EACH COMMISSION

items.texto: You get a GPS pin and a time. Nothing else. You arrive somewhere you didn't know existed (a winery, a stone courtyard) and on the door, the hairpin, engraved.
The lights go down. An engine fires up where no engine should be. Eight seconds flat out, then silence. That's all the ceremony we need: the rest of the night is yours.
One long table. Nobody at the head of it. The region writes the menu: what's eaten round here, done well. On your left a driver, on your right someone who designs helmets.

items.titulo: The table turns into a bar
items.texto: Dinner stretches on and the table becomes a bar. Music at conversation volume; after that, we'll see. The car's still there, lit up, having its picture taken.
And that's exactly the measure we care about. At the door, something for your pocket: the sticker, the race number, something to remind you tomorrow that it really happened.

secciones.nota_vacia: SAMPLE PIECES. THE PHOTO ARCHIVE ARRIVES WITH THE FIRST EVENING.

items.texto: Others have a heart or a bear. We have the hairpin: the exact point where speed turns into skill. It's in the logo, on the stickers and in every night we'll put on.

items.titulo: The car is always centre stage
items.texto: In every space there's a car lit like a museum piece. It isn't stuck in a corner: it's the centre of gravity of the night. We want people photographing it before they order their first drink.
At our evenings there's no stage and no PowerPoint: the brand lives in the glass, at the table and in the parting gift. The whole night is the message.

secciones.titulo: Tell us which race and we'll take care of the **night**.
